page.layout: Two parallel columns of index entries, left and right. The running head "INDEX." is at the top, centred. No page number or signature is printed.

page.notes: The scan is a little soft and a few numbers are superscript or partly hidden: "45¹" and "33" on the right, and the final word "fidi[?]" at the foot. The "ꝯ" mark after "310" and "510" was read as a catch or stroke, not as text. The entries are read as printed, with long s written as s and u consonants as v. The left-hand "Cosmas"/"Cosma" and "Cracouie" spellings are as far as the print can be read.
